To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that
it is possible to detect road irregularities using accelerometers of smart-phones.

1) Android smartphones with acceleromters are suitable for real-time road irregularity detection; 2) the optimal parameters for the data processing algorithm are: 0.2 m/s2 threshold and 0.5 s time window; 3) the true positive rate for road irregularity is 90% for the data collected in the city of Bratislava.
the proposed system is capable to detect road surface irregularity with high accuracy using Android smartphones and that the system can be used for road surface irregularity detection in real time.
In summary, our research is concerned with
development and evaluation of algorithms for real time pothole and crack detection.
the design, implementation and evaluation of a mobile sensing system that is capable of real time pothole detections and reporting.
the development of an Android application for real time road surface monitoring.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
the presented solution is a viable alternative for the current road infrastructure monitoring methods.
the system presented is capable to provide real time information about road surface quality and could be used for the optimization of road maintenance.
the proposed approach is a very good solution for real time road surface monitoring.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
the proposed approach is feasible and could be used for road surface quality monitoring and maintenance.
the proposed solution is a good candidate for a real-time pothole detection system for Android based smartphones.
the proposed system is able to detect the presence of potholes with a high probability.
The main takeaway from our work is that
Android OS based smart phones are a good platform for mobile sensing and data processing for road irregularities detection.
Android OS based smart phones are a suitable platform for road irregularity monitoring.
it is possible to use mobile devices with built-in accelerometers as a cheap and reliable source for road quality data.
